text: "I am writing to report a serious issue with my account. All of my coins have disappeared from the game. This has happened multiple times in the past, but this time I lost over 10 million coins. This is extremely frustrating, especially since my friends have also experienced this same issue repeatedly. Please investigate your game servers and resolve this problem as soon as possible, as it feels like a major technical flaw."

I personally liked the game but there's just to much matchmaking like the opponent just shoot wherever he wants and 2 to 3 balls sink at once and other ways of cheating like reporting doesn't help either because it just does the same thing. These things happens especially in tournaments. I would really appreciate if the game would improve these problems.

I have recently played "The Lost Gift" game, which cost 125k coins. While I potted my final ball, the app notified me that "you are ran out of time"; it then automatically returned my last ball to its previous position and gave my opponent cue ball to pot the '8-ball' and win the game. What is happening with the app? I immediately want those 125k coins returned to my account.

I have been playing this game for a long time, but recently the number of hackers has become unacceptable. In the last 2 days, I faced 7 hackers. Some players make impossible shots instantly, play without aiming properly, and clear the table in ways that are clearly not legitimate. I lost 4millions of coins because of this. The game is fun, but the anti-cheat system needs major improvement. Please take stronger action against hackers and return lost coins to affected players

Worst ever experience with this game always crashes 1). when I open the shop option then I am unable to go back to the main. I need to close the game and then reopen it. 2).When use back spin in full force it is ineffective. 3). Even With proper aim in the hole the ball came back after contacting the hole boundary I don't know how as it is a virtual game this thing can only happen in a real pool table. 4). Bringing a new game but the company is not focusing on its popular game.

I am also facing the same problem as others, hackers are playing like the game is on Auto Mode. No chance of winning any game. I have been playing this game for 15 years but never faced such things. Sorry but, will have to logout as of now otherwise all the coins which we collect through all sources goes in Vain in each game. No Point now playing this Useless game.

I would like to share some serious concerns regarding my experience while playing 8 Ball Pool. Recently, I have been encountering a large number of hackers in the game, which is making the gameplay very frustrating and unfair. Another issue I want to highlight is that whenever I open the game, it automatically suggests high-coin matches. Sometimes, I accidentally click on these high-stake games, and unfortunately, that’s where most hackers appear. As a result, I end up losing a huge coins

The UI is so slow and laggy and it have loads of annoying pop ups in game. When you start the game it shows 5-6 unnecessary pop ups. And even I have great internet speed this trash game shows slow network or other network related errors which i never experience in any other games or apps. The game is good to play but so annoying too at the same time.

I've been playing this game on n off for about 5 years now n I absolutely LOVE it! This is the only "sport" I get excited n vocal about... when I miss a shot, sink the cue or 8 ball by mistake...so many challenges, events, rewards, ways to play n you can play offline, one on one or even challenge your friends! The possibilities are endless...

So look, I would have easily without any thought given it 5 stars. It really is fun, not a difficult game and takes minimal storage space. But the reason for 2 less stars, is because it is becoming more and more buggy with every single update. I have lost a total of approximately 12k coins because it would randomly kick me from the match, close the app or like a few times, just for no reason at all, restart the entire game. And it is really frustrating to say the least.

This game is super luck based. Even on more skill based game modes (i.e, having to call which pot you will shoot in) luck is still a major factor at play, to the point it becomes frustrating. There is a layer of skill, yes, but there is no fun to be had, when you are just losing your tokens consistently, because you can't even have a single shot yourself, or your balls positions are absolutely awful, giving you a 0% chance of winning immediately after break.

I have played this game before, but took a break because something didn't add up. I'm (now) noticing the same issues. I am buying coins cos it's a fun game, but now this game is just getting greedy. what are easy shots I miss & pot the ball or I would make a shot, giving me another turn but somehow, I have lost my shot because I ran out of time?? I was watching the screen and it didn't even give me my turn. At first I thought I was just imagining it, but I know I think it's part of scam.

If it wasn't for continual pop up's for in app purchsses after every game and the absolute physics defying angles it's apparently possible to pot a ball from(I've played shots that are completely impossible, yet potted, and had them played against me), the game would be great. Sadly, it's not realistic. Also, I've restarted recently. Why am I contiually being matched with players over 100 levels above me?

Overall, it is a great game and plays well. i rated 1 star because no matter what, if you click on your rewards or just 5 game litters the screen with microtransactions. i understand they are optional, but it gets very annoying after every match when i just want to claim my rewards that another pop up for their microtransactions gets in the way.

This matchmaking is absolutely broken. I’ve spent time, bought coins, upgraded my cues, and still I keep getting matched with players way above my level. What’s the point of trying to improve or even spending money on the game if every match feels like I’m being set up to lose? It’s beyond frustrating and completely unfair. Cheaters and unfair play take all the fun out of the game. Tsk!

New record tonight, over a half hour tonight and still have yet to play a game because the app crashes and buffers and you get sent back and you have to go through the whole thing over again. what is the worst is when you do start a game and it happens there go all the coins you put up for the game gone never to be seen again. customer service or help of any kind non- existing. they don't even get back to you Worst by far of all the pool apps, if you want to play a game go somewhere else not he

I'm giving 1 star not because of the game, 'cause it's great, but since I changed my phone, whenever I enter the game, it crashes and goes back to home. I've even quit the beta program thinking it was that, but it wasn't; same problem. I've been playing this game since 2014, when it was on Facebook, and this is the first time the app ever did that. now I'm without the beta versions and the game, and apparently this has been happening to A LOT of people. I PAID THINGS IN-GAME. PLEASE, FIX IT!!!

Money suck game. Play is decent, but in 1v1 play, no matter what table you just played at, they automatically to put you at a table that is your "max bet". Not paying attention just one time, can wind up costing almost all of your coins. Typical money suck game. Edit: Tried it again a few years later, it's gotten worse, The amount of ads is asinine. And just lost most my coins on 3 8-ball run outs, never even got to shoot. Sad. Money. Suck.

"Fun game to play! Highly recommended. From me😁" that was my review 4yrs ago but now it gets 4 star. A few times, there's this bug where, if a ball is mere millimeters away from a pocket (so close to it) and you place the cue ball sticking behind it, when you shoot, the cue ball goes through said ball and scratches. Moreover, Hackers... I've reported hundreds of them and still see so much in games. When are you planning to remove them? Don't reply 'contact us...to solve issue,' no. Just Fix It.

It's okay..... its not always a fair match because you have players buying specialty cues that provide better aim, spins, etc. It'd be much more fun if everyone was evenly matched and you had to go off skill instead of how much you spent but i guess that's every games these days unfortunately! Fun to pass the time at appts though.

Man, the only thing I can say is that, 15 years of existing as a go-to enjoyable game - is more like a hilarious term now. It has so many ads. 2 games, there's ads. After exiting the ads, game will go connecting. So many pop-up entries or rewards, too many cliché before you can even play the game. The ads is more stressful and annoying to me.

so far im addicted to this game. prizes are plentiful and physics seem to be on par. best pool game i played so far. alright been playing a little bit now, and my gripes about the game. can't stand the buy this or that when you start the game. The game is good enough that you don't need to force trying to get people to buy stuff. edit: annoyed with the purchase this or that after every game and every time i log on. drop rating to 3 cause of this. If you purchase something it gets worse.

This is a very good game. However I would have hoped that for an occasion like the 15 Year Anniversary, it would be a little easier to upgrade the special 15 Year Anniversary Cue. You can spend good money to purchase an animated cue box and still not receive the special que that you seek. By all means charge for it, but perhaps make it a specific purchase so that as a player you can get exactly what you want. In my case I am simply wanting the final que to complete the upgrade. Thank you. 🙂

​"I have had a terrible experience playing 8 Ball Pool recently. The game has become absolutely frustrating because of the endless amount of ads; as soon as you finish a single match, another ad pops up immediately. On top of that, the game suffers from severe lagging issues, making it almost unplayable. To make matters worse, a massive number of players are constantly cheating, which completely ruins the fair spirit of the game. It has become a truly awful and disappointing experience."

Relaxing. I only wish the pool board was more easy to recognize solid OR a striped ball -and each shot was more "close up" and 3D: Easier to aim ones shot. (I'm over 65 years old and everything is so tiny on a cell phone. Very complicated and uncomfortable for a. elderly person to enjoy their time.) Otherwise, I seriously love playing pool and not having to stand, walk, or travel from my bedroom --(being disabled.) Thank you.

I have been playing this game for many, many years. I took a break for a few years after losing all my credits, and a few months ago decided to give it another go. I have been paying for premium every month, and enjoyed it again. Now, Im leaving again... Every second game is against some cheater with an aimbot of some sorts. They are not even hiding it, they dont even aim, just shoot and drop impossible shots. I lost 2 million in 2 days...

8 Ball Pool is the best billiards app on the market by far, but theres a couple issues. There is alot of bloatware. It usually tskes me 5 minutes to get to playing pool because of how many event announcements, point rewards, etc. that pop up. I love the different types of playing styles (Call 8 pocket, call all pockets, normal) but i wish they weren't cities. I think being able to customize sticks and tables is cool, but theres TOO MUCH BLOATWARE. Also, I think you play bots most the time, idk.

Fun timeless game but what I don't understand is why on the free spins do you offer 100,000 when it's rigged not to allow you to win it! I have a video of me pressing it to stop on the 100,000 but it all changes and you get 500 max everytime. Soo many pop ups when you load the game, friends online, offline, game invites, new game styles, prices, offers, and more and more. Going on for a quick single game you need 30 seconds just to allow all thr pop ups.

CHEATERS CHEATERS CHEATERS! There are sooo many accounts using hacks that it completely takes the fun out of the game completely. I build and build my money to get to a higher table and constantly loose to players using hacks to run the entire table off. Not aiming shots or making shots full send so quickly it would be impossible to aim but the ball always somehow sits where they need it for the next impossible shot. 5 wall bank shots, 3 ball combo shots...over and over. Im done with this game.

The game is great, but the user interface is completely rigged. Every time you open the game or go to the 1v1 section, it automatically scrolls and selects the highest possible bet table based on your coins. This is a cheap "Dark UX" trick to force accidental mis-clicks so players lose all their hard-earned coins and are forced to buy real ones. ​We need a "Default Table Lock" or the game should always open the lowest bet table by default, not the highest! Fix this scammy feature. Giving 1 star

I wish the game was more balanced and fair. I'm only level 32, but every so often it makes you go against an opponent a WAY higher level than you. I just went against a level 214 today. It happens too frequently imo and you lose because of it majority of the time. There also so many pop-ups that make it feel like the devs are begging for money. Also why the heck did they add ads? They've had 0 for the longest time. It's unfortunate this is the best version of the game or I'd download a new one.

I want my play points back lol, crazy to find out that if you dont play the game, you lose your account. Stopped playing back in 2019 or something like that, saw that there was a neat noble frame to use my play points on, just to re-download the game and find out that my account is gone. Got the frame, but im not going to waste my time on a game that won't help in any way. Unfortunate too as my other account had a lot of time and money put into it, so it's pretty upsetting. Is what it is, though

My experience playing 8 Ball Pool was phenomenal before this update. Now, players seem to be cheating by using the cue ball to make impossible shots, which feels really strange and unfair. At first, I thought it was just a one-time thing, but after playing more matches, I kept seeing it happen again and again. Please fix this issue because I truly love your game and enjoy playing it. I just want the game to feel fair and fun again for everyone.

Wanted to redownload and play an old game I used to enjoy, but the first thing you see are 20 forced pop-up ads, half even without an "x" to back out of them, and you're stuck there trying to quick close everything, just for them to put a sneaky "ad reward" button where the backout button was supposed to be and force you into yet another ad that you can't skip. Absolutely ridiculous. I deleted the game without even playing a round. I understand needing to make money, but this is pathetic devs.

I have been playing 8 Ball Pool for more than 4 years and I really enjoyed the game. In the past, hackers were very rare, and when they appeared, they were usually banned quickly. Now the situation feels completely different. Almost every 2–3 games, I get matched against a player who appears to be using cheats. These players make impossible shots with perfect accuracy and seem to have unfair advantages. What is even more frustrating is that reporting them does not seem to have any effect,

Incessant ads; you can do nothing without a pop-up (or 2 or 3) hounding you for money. Physics is terrible; try to make a simple bank shot with just the cue ball (zero english) and it goes nowhere close to where it should. Frequently stalls then blames "Waiting for a response from your opponent" when no response is even possible. Gotta watch a video to proceed, but no way to return to game without restart. Moving power control often moves cue at same time, causing a miscue. UNINSTALLED.

Very glitchy, often completely crashes during games causing me to automatically lose. Freezes for minutes at a time if you or your opponent's connection isn't perfect. Does not save customizations to the chat order for more than a day or two. Pop-up ads are incredibly annoying, it's like they want you to accidentally buy something. I wish there was a good alternative with physics as realistic as this, because this app is awful. The game itself is coded flawlessly, but everything around it sucks.

There's a lot to say about this game, most of it negative so I'd start with the positives! It looks okay and plays well enough. A few things I hate is how it constantly tries to make u buy their virtual coins and spend real money on a game this simple. It even makes you buy "chat texts"!!! You have to unlock texts just to use them in game and with friends, it's ridiculous!

I've been playing this game since 2016 and worked very hard to achieve level, collect coins. but not when you play, every game is a bot playing. Fair play is no way near and Miniclip doesn't seem to resolve the issues. it's not new it's been more than 3 years now. Crashed to thousands from billions of coins💔 This is Awful and unprofessional by miniclip and even no support in return. Now, it's time to move on from this game, we play that for fun and this ultimately leaves in trauma and anger.

Allows bot players and hackers freedom of the game, making it impossible for genuine players to enjoy the game. Seriously? what is the point of having an app if you're not going to keep an eye on it. you've got a Facebook group and the cheats are blatantly advertising their accounts and chatting with each other about the apps that help their shots.. your genuine players are starting to lose interest in the gamr because they are constantly losing, never getting a shot unless they break.

This game is full of hackers who ruin the entire experience. Even after reporting them, the developers take absolutely no action. I played 4 high-stakes matches (worth 20,000 each), and there were hackers in every single one of them. That's why I am giving it a 1-star rating. This game seems to be made only for hackers; normal players don't even get a chance to show their skills.

This game is filled with bots/hackers and when you report them nothing happens. It is even extremely obvious that the accounts are fraudulent. I believe the dev WANTS bots and hackers because it robs the coins of those who spend money, causing them to either spend MORE or not play. It is also policy to not refund coins for any reason, even when their INCESSANT ad pop ups cause you to click a match you didnt intend to play. CONSTANT popups to purchase ingame items. Unnecessary and annoying.

I paid money to buy coins and all of them got stolen by hackers in the game. It is absolutely insane how many hackers are in the game at the present moment and miniclip refuses to do anything about it. There seems to be no detection at all since many of these accounts are of higher levels and they keep on going unnoticed by miniclip. I want my money back!!!

I have Galaxy A56 phone. Can not play more than one game continuously. The device is freezing too much and can not do anything. Whole device is freezing too much. Also can't go back to home screen. Sometimes device is restarting. No error logs showing. Also device gone heated. I have canceled so many game play and can not maintain my wining rate. Please fix it. Reinstalled many times but not fixed. Give me solution.

very good game, fun but full of hackers and bots. for example today I was 25 place on the Amethyst League, First place on the Event and sudenly they reset all my points going on zero. This is crazy! I think if I won't receive them back I have to change to another game (pity) no more purchases and our road comes to an end. As I say pity couse the game was excellent. Thanks.

I will stop playing this game because of the ads. it's ridiculous, they are strong arming you into paying for there stupid pool pass or sit and watch some ridiculous ad between matches. used to be a solid game but no thanks . Make your money, but not off me man, it was cool when you got better perks and was cheap but it's ridiculous now. fk this

Ad Breaks are killing the game. The game also seems to favor players who bought pool pass or made some kind of purchase where they get incredibly lucky shots in critical moments. A shot made twice with the same cue, same distance, same strength and same effect doesn't give the same result on both tries. I guess the more you purchase the luckier you get... very disappointing and discouraging.

There is a huge, incomparible cheating problem in this game. I deleted it before because of that. Recently, I wanted to give it another chance but nope, nothing has changed. Especially at higher tables, 1 out of the 3 opponents of mine is a cheater. I'm reporting all of them but I haven't recieve even one piece of feedback. And of course, I haven't recieve any compensation

I have had enough! I have endured more than enough from you. It is absolutely outrageous that even now, during the 15th-anniversary edition, you allow hackers and cheaters to run rampant and ruin the game for fair players. I recently spent real money on the game, proving my loyalty. I was fully prepared to invest even more to develop my collection. But this is where it ends! I am officially blocking all major investments. From now on, I will buy absolutely nothing, except perhaps the Elite Pool

not enjoying this game anymore I have reporting some players and it seems nothing is being done about is. I've seen alot of players this past few days you can see they have the MOD APK that gives you longer guide lines they start the game and finish in seconds. can't carry on like this I have been playing for a while enjoyed the game alot but not anymore!!!!!!!!!

This game has become frustrating because around 80% of matches are filled with hackers or cheaters. I have reported many suspicious players multiple times, but nothing seems to happen. The anti-cheat system doesn't appear to be effective, and honest players are the ones who suffer. Please take reports seriously and improve your detection system. A great game is losing its fun because of the increasing number of hackers. Until this issue is properly addressed, I can't recommend it.

The reason I gave 1 star is that my internet connection is stable at 4 bars, but the game still lags and sometimes indicates that my time has run out when I'm literally watching my ball go in. Alternatively, it may display 'waiting for opponent' and then suddenly say I've run out of time or been kicked out of the match. Please fix this issue. I haven't played the game since 2021... And it's still the same problem in 2026.

The game is more-or-less pointless due to showing not only the predicted path of the cue ball but also the direction of target balls. Gameplay is trivial (rotate the screen to check the predicted path) so most games simply become a case of who pockets a ball first wins the entire game (many players have a 50% win rate, each game is essentially a coin flip). Horrendous amount of ads and promotions for in-app purchases and tons of pointless decorative items once past the first day or so.

Hello 8 Ball Pool Team, I want to give feedback about the Win Streak event. Previously, the event was better balanced. We used to need around 10 games with 3 chances, and the entry cost was also reasonable. The rewards felt fair and enjoyable. But now the system feels more difficult and less rewarding. We only get around 6 games with 2 chances, and the entry cost is higher. If we lose a chance, we end up spending around 50–60 coins, which makes it less enjoyable compared to before.

this game is so unrealistic. the amount of times the white goes in is unreal. I've played pool in real life long enough to know if you put back spin on a straight shot no way should it the ball spin in any other direction than backwards. I break the same way every game but get different outcomes. terrible game. the free spins you get is always either 50,150,500 never had anything but these 3 amounts. 💩💩💩

I've been playing 8 Ball Pool for a long time, but the game has become increasingly frustrating. It often feels like the algorithm doesn't allow players to maintain winning streaks after reaching a certain level. No matter how well you play, it sometimes seems like the system is working against you. Another major issue is the presence of hackers. I've encountered players who appear to be using aim hacks, impossible spin control, and unrealistically perfect . Only waste of time now days.

Became totally useless these days. Too many Hackers / Bots paying the game. they can pot the balls wherever and in whichever direction they hit the ball. surely a human is not doing this. today I lost 50+ games to such bots. a straight forward shot is played by rebounding the ball and still perfect angle and ball is potted. too many bots playing in multiple stages. once their turn the game is over as other person will not get a chance to play.

If there's a game that deserves 1 star or less is this one. The app is borderline unplayable, when you open the game everything is bugged out and non touchable. takes a huge amount of time to load... and it's an ad, after ad after ad. The game itself is also unplayable with large amount of cheaters in high stack tables. for anyone considering downloading this app, I recommend finding another hobby.

been playing this off and on for 15 years, when it first came out it was an amazing game and then they started adding upgrades and giving people advantage to those who are willing to pay. I log on now for the first time in 5 years and I get assaulted with constant ads, takes me 10 minutes just to play a game of pool and after two games I'm out of tokens and I have to spend money to keep playing... I just want to play a game of pool to decompress from a long day of work..

Apparently, 7 years old me got mad and left a 1 star review, so I'm here to say this is an amazing game that I have SO MUCH FUN playing with my family. No background music, no flashing lights all over, no ads in your face every game, just the sound of the cue hitting the cue ball. HOWEVER, the home screen has WAY too many pop-ups, like, it takes 3 minutes to get them all off.

I am extremely disappointed with the current state of the game. Despite putting in significant effort to earn coins, hackers are consistently exploiting the system and taking away the results of my hard work. This issue has made it very difficult to enjoy a single match, and it is discouraging for genuine players who are trying to progress fairly. i have reported lots of hacker while playing this game but there is any no improvements. The hackers are keep on joining the game continuously.

I've been playing 8 Ball Pool for a long time, but hackers have completely ruined the experience. There's no fun left when so many players are cheating. If this issue isn't addressed soon, many loyal players will stop playing and eventually quit the game altogether. Please take stronger action against hackers to keep the game fair and enjoyable. Don't play this game In all matches come to hacker.

I am extremely disappointed. After playing for years, the game has become unbearable. The prizes are useless, and the 'Lucky Spin' is a joke—it never gives more than 250 coins. What if I don't want the Pool Pass? ​Progressing through leagues is impossible because the game is crawling with bots, especially in high-stakes matches. We spend hours grinding for coins just to lose them to bots. ​Fix the game! After so many years, you should be improving it, not making it worse. I am very dissatisfied

Been playing for years! Decent at it! Best mobile game ever! unfortunately I have to admit as soon as the add pops up between each game is when I close the app out... don't mind watching the ads for the coins but when you add an advertisement 2 to 3 game ratio.... it's over with the close the app out because I don't want to wait on a stupid commercial basically.... other than that still love your game really good at it... so I learned and I'll continue to play it but still fix it maybe,???

Fun but broken. Very fun pool game. easy to learn. the matchmaking is extremely broken though. by level 10 i am facing levels 115 to 180 players with maxed out stats. cant win when they dont even have to try to play because they have perfect cues that help them play. nothing seems to fix it. starting at level 5 to 10 you will never see another low level player. they all have high levels and higher stats to give them a huge advantage. they probably also all have spent money to get better stats.

So far I haven't had any problems with this app or its performance. There is a lot less lag / crashing than there was just a couple of years ago. I've played this game on and off for several years now, so I can confirm that. I like the different table options and price points. If you want to buy anything in game, The pool pass is really cool, it offers a lot of really neat items.

They introduced mandatory ads that they didn't have before. While they had in-game ads for items you could purchase, which at times was annoying. The newly introduced in-game ads because you haven't made a in game purchase is just the icing on the cake that puts a sour taste in my mouth. If this is the new norm then I'll end up going from a daily player to a once in a while player.

The game seems to be wildly against 8 ball runs. nearly all games result in all players starting with good lead, getting a bad roll. By far the most frustrating though, is the shot clock getting shorter and shorter if youre on a long run. i frequently get to the 8 or9 ball and can't even get it lined up because i have what feels like 5 seconds to shoot. i haven't timed it but it is SIGNIFICANTLY less than you get on your first shots before starting a run.

changing my 5 star review to 1 star. used to love this game, now I've come back to it after a year or so, and I've lost over 100 million coins to hackers or bots, whichever it is. I just played 5 games in a row against them, and they somehow get to break every time, so I don't even have a chance to break and run the table. they don't miss, even when it's a seemingly impossible shot, they bank it off 6 walls, 4 balls, then boom, it goes in the pocket they called. used to he a great game. not now.

The matchmaking in this game is broken. As a lower-level player, I am constantly forced to play against opponents over level 200. Today, out of 30 games, only 3 were against people near my level. It is impossible to progress or enjoy the game when you are constantly outmatched and losing all your coins to high-level players. The developers need to fix the matchmaking logic to make it fair for everyone, not just those at the top.

I have only been playing for one day and I'm already frustrated with the store pop-up after every action on the app. I just want to enjoy the game without having to close pop-ups please. Also, what's the idea of pairing a newbie like me with higher rated players? I'm only in level 11 and I'm stuck because I'm been paired with level 60 and above. I keep loosing and I'm almost out of game credit... that explains the pop-ups anyway. Honestly, the game experience is frustrating please fix it.

It's a great game and I love playing it, however it's rife with cheaters atm. You can report cheaters when playing, but even when you do you still don't get your entry fee back. I hope the developers are trying to stamp it out. Apart from that, maybe a good improvement would be to be to only be able to hit the cue ball in certain places when hampered by other balls or the cushion.

I've played a few matches after downloading the game, and surprisingly I've met 2x more people brazenly hacking. they don't even try to hide it, the guide line is pointing in one direction and the cue ball goes another, banking off the walls multiple times before potting a ball, no need for adjustments, they just full send it and it always lands.

Not bad for a bit of fun. Get too many mismatched opponents (me lvl 14 vs level 200+). Too many things popping up, not ads, just trying to get you to sign up to everything or buy in app stuff. Then there's the issue of trying to find an opponent and the wheel just spins and spins and never selects anyone. If you don't take it serious and don't mind shutting a few popups down begging for money, it's OK I suppose.

Terrible. Tried playing the beginner matches, and it kept putting me up against high level players, who always seem to get to go first, and then they proceed to never miss a shot. Constantly lost games I never even got a chance to play. Its sad that the beginner matches has such high level players constantly queuing into it.

this app has kicked me out multiple times and made me start from scratch. also, most recently, I've been getting notifications that I'm transferring coins or whatever between multiple apps and I haven't been. I wasn't able to contact anybody about that. and I just logged in and found out that my 63 million coins in my wallet have been reduced to 73,000. I'm not sure if they were hacked or stolen or just taken by the app but it's extremely frustrating.

probably the slowest app I've used in year's. The game will consistently crash or just never load into anything. Not to mention you have to pay real money to have anything in game that's even worth using because you could never put the time into earning it yourself because of bugs, lagging and game crashing. kind of sad when you Google how much the game developers actually make off our pockets and can't even give back appreciation by keeping a app up to standard.

Frustrated.. In the middle of the games, it suddenly tells me that connection is slow and my time is running out.. And the opponent's turn, win the match.. What's even sadder, when the network is connected, it is suddenly pop up to home and I lose the game.. I don't have any issues with other games apps.. Only this game.. I spent a lot of time building up my winnings, then the daily challenges started to give challenges where I'd have to play in higher stake games, these games are impossible to win. You can plan every shot, and then the game physics do their own thing, and you end up snookering yourself or potting the white.

The game is great. It really good for when you want to play a casual game of 8 ball and it's other variants. Offline mode is especially great. I'm giving this 2 stars because of one major issue; the dang ads. There are so much ads. In no world should there be an ad break in a competitive online game. Yes, I understand you guys need to make money but no way I'm believing you guys that you DONT make enough money with all of those micro transactions. An ad every time you press something is horrible

In terms of dynamics, the game is realistic. I do hate the amount of ads, either the ads we all know, or the ads of the game itself. I constantly get stuff like new cues advertised for me and I'm slowly getting sick of it. Especially cuz the luck games are made to think you have a chance, but the algorithm sucks so bad, I am honestly shocked. I only got the two worst possible rewards over 10 times in a row. The gameplay itself is solid though. So 3 stars seem fair.

Downloaded, loved it, it's now uninstalled. I agree with most recent reviews, there definitely seems to be some form of algorithm in this game recently to get you to buy more coins. It lures you in with winning streaks and all the perks then as previous reviews have said, it quickly turns to nothing but losses and 0 'coins' and inundated with adverts for buying more - not happening. It's taken all the fun out of it. At first I thought it was me, but I'm glad I've come to read the reviews.

I recently played the 8 Pool game, and I was thoroughly disappointed. The graphics were outdated, making it feel like I was playing a game from a decade ago. The controls were unresponsive and made aiming and striking the cue ball frustratingly difficult. The gameplay was also riddled with bugs and glitches, leading to several instances where the game froze or crashed altogether. On top of that, the matchmaking system seemed broken, often pairing me with opponents way out of my skill range. 😑

This game is infuriating. Graphics are great, gameplay is fun... until you start ranking up. As so many others have said, in the beginning, you win a large percentage of games, then, as you rank up, it becomes that you can't make even simple shots, while your opponent makes even the hardest. I've played from start several times as a guest, and it is the same. Everytime I start getting near level 20 and 500,000 to 800,000 coins, I suddenly can't win. Zero chance I'd ever spend real $ on this.

This is a fun game when it works. However, you constantly lose connection to server, won't find you an opponent to play against, people quit games after one shot and when it does kick you out due to server loss you still lose coins. You have to use your coins to play offline and there are so many adds to become a premium member. The core pool playing is quite fun and when it works well it's very addictive. Pre written chat options keep it friendly but you can buy more chat options, which seems like a bit of a money grab in all honesty. You seem to get regular boxes that unlock new clue pieces which adds something different to what could be a very one dimensional game. If the servers work properly it is a genuine fun game to play whether you are interested in pool or not. The rest of the time it make you wonder why you keep reopening it.

I rank it higher than 1 or 2 simply because I did have fun playing it. I took away two stars because the game is definitely rigged so that you'll win 2/5 games (not calculated stats), so you feel like you MIGHT make it to the next club, but then you ultimately will keep dropping, so you pay money to retain your spot. If you're a progress based person like me, not your game. If you're fine just playing a game here or there in the cheaper clubs, this is a great game for you.

Now, I like this game, but sometimes it is just SO damn glitchy, causing the experience to be horrible, for example, the cue is INSANELY hard to control, it spins around and is really annoying. Playing online is fun, and entertains me, but I have had a lot of glitches. Also, pop ups are very annoying, i can't start a game without getting asked to spend £10 on a cue. So, fun game, but quite.... glitchy and annoying.

Win a couple, lose a few.. I used to always play.. then I stopped because its algorithm is not random (who it chooses for you to play).. This game is designed for you to eventually lose your coins (as it places you with people with much more experience than you) so you began to spend. It's not just you, it's everyone as this complaint is a very common one. Very fun IF you don't get caught up in playing high stake games. Just play the cheap ones and have fun..

I like it, it looks good, but the reason for only 3 stars is one the time limit. i can see why they have the time limit, but it is to fast. they show that different pool cues give you more time, but i have timed them, 30 seconds is what you get. i have lost so many games because my time had just ran out before i shoot. Second is the Spin & Win and Lucky Shot where you can win coins. These are both so rigged so u win the bear minimum.

Over the Top Comeons and Ads! It is constantly trying to sell you perks for the game, constantly interrupting you with it, and it has lengthy ads that play very often, too. It is a beautiful game, but the constant, and I mean CONSTANT comeons to make purchases and frequent, lengthy ads, makes it far too annoying to try to get into. It is one of the worst apps for this kind of thing I have ever had on my phone.

The game itself tries to balance the skillful players and players who base their skills on luck. Although the game itself is straightforward and simple to the point of it allows younger players to play. There is only two flaws in this in my opinion. First is the banners, as they should be a one time thing and should not open again whenever the player is in the menu or selecting a game. Secondly ads, do not put ads to whenever a player lose as it adds to the stress of the players mental state.

Constantly robbed. I will make two balls in a row and then my turn will suddenly stop because I "took to much time", and my shots didn't even count. Wouldn't be a big deal if it didn't happen ALL THE TIME. Especially when you're spending money. AND there is no way to contact the developers to inform them to have them fix the issue or refund your money you just lost because the game is consistently GLITCHY.

Not a bad game but my God are the ads ridiculous. They pop up after almost every screen change and they place the "buy now" button right on top of the "ok" or "continue" button. Its really pretty sleazy. I get that they want to make money for their product(and they should, its a decent mobile game) but the constant ads make the game unplayable.

Excellent game!! shame about the ads!!! THEY ARE SO F#*€ING ANOYING!!! If people want to buy in'app purchases they will!!,STOP Bullying people into spending!!!! It ruins the game experiance!!!!. A few things that I'd like to see implemented into the game.. 1.ability to track where your coins have gone!. 2. Ability to chat with friends outside a game. 3. History of who you've played, wins/losses.4. And would be nice if there was some background music of your choice!!.

This game is a great idea that is poorly executed. Great gameplay, sweet graphical environment, and good sound effects. But there are many things I dislike, I just cannot recommend this game to others. - CHALLENGING OTHERS - There's no reason why I should be getting so many notifications, when a "friend" opens the game. The only friends I'd like to be notified when they become online, are those who I frequently play with. - MICROTRANSACTIONS - Put as many microtransactions as you want. But for the love of God, don't advertise it so much. I've pressed the x button on notifications more times than I've potted the 8-ball. - MORE GAME MODES - I've been playing since 2016 and the only other gamemode, other than 8-ball, is 9-ball? With such good game design, there could be a Snooker mode or French-style mode added to the game. - SCORE - I happen to have a tablet, with the same account logged on, and the score vs. any friend is different on my devices. Sometimes it randomly changes back to 0 or even add/remove points. Also, my friends see a completely different score than I do. - FREE PLAY - Quick fire and pass 'n' play are good game modes. But I would love to have a free space where I can practice my shots without time or score over my head.

First, I dislike the fact that when you get a LEGENDARY box you might get the same piece over and over. Secondly, the spin NEVER gives high prizes, not even when you purchase it. Lastly, I purchased Golden Spin and won 4 Legendary boxes. I opened 2 and then had an incoming call, I answered and when I was done I went back into game. But I could no longer get the remaining boxes. I contacted cust. service and they said I did receive it. Which is complete BS. I'm seriously debating deleting app!!!!

The worst part about this game is that ; it eats out of your pocket (you'll need to use real money to keep in it ) so for me it's hardly a game since a $ (dollar) is worth almost 20 bucks. It would be a greater game or the greatest of all if I were to progress only by in-game coins and cash. I'm just going to snooze it for a year I think, I've got heaps of books to read and pets to run after !

It would be nice if there was a way to report cheaters who use guideline apps on top of the game. This game used to be fun, but now you watch people make impossible shots, and easily win games before you even get a chance to shoot once. It's also not fair to be matched against players who are 30 levels higher than you. Seriously? I'm supposed to beat a level 45, at level 12? I'm so close to uninstalling. I just watched 70k coins of mine disappear, and somehow have lost 25 games straight. HOW?!

Fun arcade-style pool, a great way to distract yourself. In one week I put several hours in already. It's got some issues though. I don't know if games are through a server or peer2peer, but it is very common to get disconnected from a match even on high-speed wifi. This gets only more frustrating at higher level competitive play. Sometimes you will make a shot only to get disconnected and find out that you lost your turn on time. Beware the many gambling mechanics in-game. Easy to spend money

The only thing I don't like is when you play someone with a cheat. You can tell when they wait until time is about out, with no movement, then the stick automatically aims, shoots the shot and makes even nearly impossible shots. I take screen shots of the players that cheat, but have no way to pass the information on to correct the issue. Get rid of those dicks and it's a 5 star!! Update 11-7-22: Still no contact, and cheats still going on. Reduced to 1 star.

Update; it's getting worse..... I wanted to rate 5. I abso love this game. Find it hard when I'm forced to lose, multiple times. I was forced to not make a shot or my cue ball gets forced into a hole. Others with higher ranks are the ones I tend to have the most issues with. Amazing, this game has helped me with English and ball placement. It just sucks for these minor details. Makes me not want to play anymore. I mean what's the point. I'll await a response if not I'll have to delete app

Advertisement pops up after the end of every game badgering you to make in app purchases. I've been playing this game for years, I buy the pool pass for every event AND I have spent well over $1,000 in total on this game. I shouldn't have to deal with lagging and glitching, waiting forever for the screen to unfreeze on my opponents turn because THEY have slow internet. Nor should I have to deal with ads for in game purchase. I am a VIP member for crying out loud.

Loved the game since it at least 8 years ago. I also hate it, been playing fairly consistently for a week. But I can't progress anywhere. And it's not actually my fault. I win enough coins from playing 4 or so matches to progress to the next table. But when I bet my coins on the new table my opponent always seems to win without me getting to play. Absolutely stupid. Not to mention I can't collect gifts even though I have received th from friends.

If I could give them zero stars I would. DO NOT download this game. After years of playing and overlooking the countless cheaters with aim bots making impossible shots, I can't forgive that they allowed my winnings to be stolen. Their "customer support" is absolutely worthless. Instead of helping with my issue, they send what is basically a form letter with ridiculous excuses that boiled down to I was either a cheater or stupid, neither of which are true. This game is absolute trash.

this used to be a great game, until an update a few months ago. now, when you are trying to control the power meter on many shots, it adjusts the angle of the cue stick instead. you end up with time running out, while your frantically readjusting the angle to where you had it and trying to get the power control to pick up instead. i was a very good player, but just get ticked off at it now. and there's no way to contact their support team. i think I'm done with it!

The graphics are ok, but the game play is awful. My first game, I did the tutorial and was then put up against someone ranked at 150. I hit one time in that game. The thing that catches people out as well is that the cues are rentals. I got a nice cute in a gift box but lost all money because I didn't realize it costs 31500 for every 50 shots. When you play badly, 50 shots is quick. (Practice games that you PAY TO PLAY count against that 50 shot counter.) Not for me...

Updating my review after nearly 6yrs: I love pool, this is the best app on the market for it. (3*->2*) Bombarded with advertisements. Microtransactions are not only still pretty costly, but even more abundant. Still unable to play for free without rewards with friends. Game works harder to sell you currency packs and weighted minigames to mitigate your losses on the tables with good rulesets than it does actually giving you the game. Just don't forget to buy your skill with a good stick.

Updating my review (it was 4 stars). I stopped playing for a long time and just recently came back to the game. Biggest complaints is in regard to matches without guidelines. The matches without guidelines now doesn't have you choose pockets for balls. Terrible idea. Also you can no longer play friends without guidelines, why? Never annoyed by these things. And the microtransactions have only gotten worse. Please at least fix the matches without guidelines and let us play them with friends.

It's a great pool game... but if you want to actually do any of the other stuff in the game, there is no purpose in playing pool for that stuff, the in game currency doesn't actually buy anything anymore, tho it used to, of course they decided to go with the microstransaction route with loot boxes and that, but... doing all of that made the game lose its purpose and made it boring, so... in summary, it sucks

I got this game after playing 8 ball on my friends iPhone. I was really good in that platform. But this is different. Having played billiards in real life, I know what to expect. The physics are very wrong is this game. The felt table in the game slows the balls down very quickly. Also, moving the cue is very awkward. I didn't really enjoy it, but I'm sure many people feel differently. Overall, wouldn't recommend.

This game is actually fun. But I just don't like the way to find opponents. Why can't I cancel the search when looking for opponents. This game should have a feature to cancel. we want to fight or not. Or try adding a feature to confirm we will fight it or not. I was very disappointed when I accidentally pressed the search for an opponent, so the coins that I collected were wasted. My conclusion. Please add a feature to cancel when we accidentally pressed the opponent's search. Thank you.

@ M MC I totally agree with you, years ago I loved this game, way to much going on in it now AND PLEASE STOP THE POP UP SUGGESTIONS TO PLAY YOUR FRIENDS OR ACCEPT THEIR CHALLENGES. I just want to get on a play sometimes, instead I spend most of the time clicking an x. It's so aggrevating I turn it off and don't play often anymore. I had to turn notifications off on my phone, it was something every second. I deleted the app for a while, but my family wanted me to rejoin.

Now when one of your sales ad pop up, the exit button (X) choses when to work, sometimes it does and most times doesn't and I never had any such experience till I did the recent update. The reconnection issue is going to make you lose alot of players if you don't fix quick ..I've lost over 200k coins in a week to glitches, I'm not complaining much because I'm a pretty good player and can win more money, but with more glitches? I'd probably have to look up a better 8 ball pool game.

Updating should be made easier. I play this game on two devices, and I can't update to play with friends on my second device, and a shot clock should be a shot-clock, it shouldn't move faster just because you potted more balls. So I have a chance to earn a free dollar for watching a video.The problem is, for about the last three weeks, there have been no videos available. Not really a big deal, but a buck is a buck.

The game it self is fun, for a while, u think the pockets are a bit too forgiving tho. But I'm installing the app because really this game is half a step away from being a gambling ap. You can't lose a game or mini game without being prompted 'are you sure? For just $1.49 you can try again!' there's a difference between offering pay to play and trying to guilt people into paying for "just one more turn".

The games good when its not robbing your coins. I've noticed that when you play low coin games it runs smoothly. But soon as you play big coin games (Jakarta and above) and your having a good win streak, the game suddenly gets interrupted every minute with a "slow connection" alert that makes you lose your turn eventually leading to you losing the whole game (and your coins). Seems like a scam to make you pay real money to buy coins. I'll never pay real money anymore to buy coins.

Ok I pay $5.00 for the best cue stick and initially I get good results. I was able to do some good things on quick fire and got a score over 90000 . However now I do good if I can reach 20000. The main reason is because all of a sudden it will not give me a ball on the break especially from the 2nd rack on. Before if I had the cue ball in the right position in the middle of the table, I could get 2 or 3 at least. Now I'm lucky to get 1. It's no coincidence. It's a scheme to get you to pay more.

If I could give it a zero I would. I have lost millions of coins after playing for years. Instead of being rewarded for my wins. I have lost 100's of thousands of coins even after a win. I just lost 100,000 coins after winning a 5000 coin game. This has been ongoing for month. I like the game play but the algorithms suck! Some of those coins I actually paid for... not happy! There is no way to contact the company.

This was one of my favorite games. I just went to play again for the first time in a while and all of my progress is gone, rank, sticks, tables, currency. I can't even login to any account due to "connection error". I refuse to play as a guest after putting years of time and effort into my actual account. I just want to log in again. Seeing as this seems to be a pretty widespread issue, you think you guys would fix the problem... or I guess we're all just screwed out of our time and money?

Fun at first. The pop ups are ridiculous. Every time you get out of a game, a new pop up comes up for you to buy something before you can select anything. It annoyingly sets you up to the most expensive game to go into, instead of the last one played. Putting money on this game isn't worth it, the graphics when collecting is so long and unable to be cut short. So if you play a few tables and earn a few levels, it takes about 10 mins to collect, just watching and waiting on graphics to stop.

I do really love this game, but starting as of last week every like 1 - 2 minutes it will freeze and "reconnect" which is extremely frustrating when you are in the middle of a game. And every few games it will just kick me out of the game, and I lose the money I put down on the game. Once this issue is resolved, the game will easily be 5-Stars.

Almost every time i get my daily spin i either get 75, 150, or 250 coins. I've even paid for the 99 cent spin and i still dont get anything really high. I've gotten 250 or lower for basically the last 2 years. That is one of the major reasons i dont get on more often. Getting that small spin just annoys me so i stop playing. I would really like that fixed because it cant just be random odds that i get the same thing every time. This game has went down in quality for sure. I'd give 0/5 if I could

This game is a wreck. Spins are NOT truly random. I played for years and have only gotten 50, 150, 250 etc. It's around a 10% chance to get 100k but I've spun it hundreds if not thousands of times and have never gotten 100k. Your cues are pay to win, A LOT of connectivity issues, & half the time you play against bots that change in difficulty based on how much you're winning. I'd also like to throw in the fact that I get 5 screens asking me to pay constantly. These are just a few of the issues.

Very nice gameplay, but lots of pop up offers/unlocks/etc that get in the way. Reduced my rating to 3* because there's a persistent problem with players using cheating tools that mean they never miss, even impossibly hard shots. Miniclip have been unable to prevent this for over a year now and it impacts about 1 in every 3 games I play. It's spoiled an otherwise great game that I previously spent hundreds of hours and plenty of real $$ on. Now I'm taking a break.

Those ad-break is just annoying as hell! Every 2 to 3 games it always pops up. I just want to play without any ads popping up. Devs should just remove it cause it's pretty useless, you're just ruining the fun and momentum of the game. And the lucky spin, 15 out of 15 spins I never got anything more than 2500 coins, not a single rare or legendary box. The match making is also unfair, I just created a new account only at Lvl 6 but they match me with a Lvl 57, 63, 45, etc. You better fix it!!! 😑😑

While this game can be very fun and addicting it can also be extemely frustrating. If you are like me you are probably playing casually to kill some time. The problem is there is no sense matchmaking by level. I am only level 16 and I am always getting paired against level 100+. This game is also pay to win. My opponents always have these ridiculous cues where the line showing the direction of the ball stretches across the damn table. This game could be good but the inbalances make it bad.

This is the first game where you can't unfriend someone. There was also a delay on getting coins. In order to get the coins, you had to send an email and then they fixed it. Granted they fixed the problem in one day. Why is the internet connection very slow in certain areas where I'm at??? The slow internet connection cost me a lot of coins and it makes the game look horrible bad. There are only 2 Facebook friends that play this game and there are people on my list of Facebook friends that aren't my Facebook friends anymore. They need to update that stuff but they don't and another pathetic thing that makes the game undesirable to play. These are the reasons why I hardly play this game.

This game can get very annoying and seems extremely rigged. Every time I get a scratch-off, it's worth almost nothing. Same for the daily spin, the usual payout 99.99% of the time is either 50 or 100 coins. Never anything good like 5k, 10k or 25k even though those are on the wheel constantly. Worst is when I adjust the strength for a shot and it seems like I did nothing different. It's like the ball already has a predetermined outcome if the strength is at a certain level.

This game is good except for: 1. It tries to persuade you into purchasing more items. a. Spin and win, always gives you small amount of coins. What are the odds? And you always miss that 50000 coins or 500 cash. Then they ask if you want to purchase b. When you win so many games, you start to loose because you miss some easy shots. They make you feel like you need to purchase better cues. 2. When you hit more than 5 balls in a raw, the time reduced to even 2 sec? How to score in 2!

I've been using my Miniclip account for so many years to play 8ball. But suddenly when i tried to login to the same account to play the game it said email & password incorrect. When I try to reset the password it shows me an error & their support says that the acc can't be recovered. Also, lost all of my coins, cues everything. Really disappointed with them that they aren't able to resolve this issue. UNINSTALLED IT FOREVER!!

Good day. I believe that users are using mods and playing online. I am only level 17 and I have encountered players whose guidelines, go off the screen, making it extremely easy to attempt shots. Players also hit bad shots but the ball still goes in, all the time! I've also lost to a match without even playing. There were no connection problems. Please give us feedback and I think you should add a Report user... This is the reason as to why I'm eating 3 stars, otherwise I would give you 5 stars.

No fair match making system. I was a level 15 against a level 103...cause that's totally fair. Not to mention the amount of cheaters. The game will temporarily freeze due to your opponents "connection" then like 30 seconds, it reconnects and they magically pot 3 balls from one shot. Absolutely ridiculous. Unless you want to cheat, you won't have fun.

All about the $$$. My wife and I love this game and play it all the time. The only pet down is the pricing for in-game cues, currency, etc. It's ridiculously expensive. £44.99 for some coins, notes a cue, and some spins on a wheel. It's just pure greed and is the reason we don't purchase anything. We want to support the development, etc, but seriously, most AAA games don't cost as much as this stuff. Greed.
game its very good,but add replay mode in last pot back ball

I loved this game up until 3 weeks ago when I went to login in & it told me I need 20mb of space to play the game & it said I had any problems to email Mini Clip which I'll be doing too. But I went to all my apps & cleared the cache. Tried logging in again, that didn't work. So I uninstalled it & then reinstalled. It worked! But only for that night, the next time I tried to login in, it did the same thing. I did the same steps as before, got it to work. As well as 3rd time. I want to add more.

The fix is clearly in on this game. Far too often, it's much like wrestling where the outcome is pre-determined. I've been playing for a long time, and I can tell you this game is almost equal parts luck and skill. DO NOT spend money in game. Try to learn in free mode. I'm telling you, it's not all skill, and you see a whole lot of borderline miraculous nonsense happen over and over... Too many idiot hackers that have absolutely ruined the gameplay, and shame on miniclip for allowing it.

8 Ball Pool by Miniclip is a fun pool game where you can play with friends or other players worldwide. The controls are easy, and the game is simple to pick up. You can earn coins to unlock new cues and tables, adding some variety. There are also in-app purchases, but they’re optional. The game physics make it feel realistic, and the aiming guide is helpful. Overall, it’s a great choice for pool fans or anyone looking for a quick, fun game. Highly recommend..!

The game keeps freezing in the middle of random matches and when it starts working again, I've already lost. Not to mention the multiple times the game tells me that I took too long, already after I've made my move and saw the match going. If these aren't fixed and keep happening as often as they do, I will not hesitate to uninstall it.

I actually like the game but I've gotten screwed twice now. They have this thing in the beginning of the game where you can win prizes by spinning a wheel. I've had no problem with this until one time a few months ago I hit 5,000 "coins" and all of a sudden the game crashed and never got credited with it. Never thought much about it until it happened yesterday. Good game but certain aspects I'm sure their rigged

This game is fun and can be addicting. The few issues I have when given a box it will disappear and you cannot open it. Also, when I win I don't get my coins if anything it takes away more coins. Also when you lose its takes away more coins. At first I thought I was losing it. Till I took screenshots before and after matches. Plus side there are opportunities to get coins but it's aggravating to see this occu

cant take a shot anymore. used to love the game, redownloaded it cause my friends wanted me to play but I cant take a shot anymore. everytime I go to pull the cue back, it moves the position of the stick instead of putting power on. I played 3x 200k games and managed to successfully take one shot, which was a miss due to it constantly moving. Sort it out

I enjoy the game, but hate how they pair you up on the matchmaking. You can be level 10 and will get paired up against a level 65. Most times playing against a very experienced player means loosing on the first or second round. Other than that I would say the pop-ups are annoying when you are just trying to play the game. I enjoy the game itself however. It is a great time killer, and I enjoy playing with my friends.

Don't waste your time. Spin to win and scratchers give no big amounts. Cash is scarce unless you pay. Most boxes give you what you already have. When you start out it seems okay, but when you try to build up coins you lose several games in a row. It doesn't matter what table you play. Also, this game is hacked. I've seen the most impossible shots go straight in. DON'T SPEND YOUR MONEY HERE. You'll only lose more. This game is DELETED.

It's a fun addictive game. But, the cue needs recharged too often, and is too expensive. Also, in order to get the better cues, you will need to end up spending money. Also another thing I don't like is they did away with the daily free dollar, now it takes way too long to get enough to do anything, or you need to spend money

I used to play for at least an hour a day. then i couldn't stand it any more. there is just too much... mini games popups .. events .. you open the game and before you can play a 1 vs 1 you have to click like a 30 clicks. then when you go to 1 vs 1 by default it always selects the max money you can afford so that if you click play by mistake you loose your money. I totally stopped playing because now when i open the game i feel stressed and overwhelmed

I've had this game for many years now. It has been good. Unfortunately it has gone from a well balanced game to a money grab. I did a trial. I used 20 spin to wins and 3 out of the 20 times paid more than 250. Scam. The game it self is also flawed. I find the ball will travel further or won't go exactly where you aim it, resulting in some instances a loss. Money money money! Give me all your money! Of course you aren't forced but it puts you in that position to maybe throw a few bucks in it

PLEASE?! Do something about your servers!! There is nothing more frustrating that having confidence in winning a game, and all of a sudden, the game will stop due to "connection issues," only to return and find you've completely missed your turn. Every time it happens (meaning this happens consistently) I contemplate deleting the app.

I have been playing this game for years So I have built up alot of cues, rewards, money, and XP. I just changed phones and downloaded the app. I signed in with Google play but none of my in app info is there except my level which is what it was on old phone. I really loved this game. I deleted the app because my years worth of XP, cues, cash, coins, etc are gone forever. Developer says they can't help. I'm still at level 39 but nothing else. Wasted my time. I'll find a new app.

It's happened twice now where my opponent breaks, does NOT get a ball in, and then gets to go again without me going. Please fix this. Overall a pretty good and solid game though and i would totally recommend it to pool fans.
